title: Portmeirion Sophie Conran White Toast rack
text: Portmeirion Sophie Conran White Toast rack. So I took a cruise and the butler served our toast on a toast rack... it was always crispy.  The secret?  A toast rack.  I bought 2.  This one and a wire one.  This one, while more than twice the price, has proved well worth it.  The ceramic tray attached to the bottom helps to keep the toast in place, a critical aspect in design I discovered. Since I love a very thin piece of bread (it gets crisper) the wire rack failed to hold the toast.  You can put the wire rack on a plate, but honestly this one is SO much more elegant AND functional.  Do I use it every day?  No.  But I love to bring it out when my Mom comes to stay as she is a big fan of crispy toast as well and a delicious marmalade.  I was worried it would be too fragile, but it is actually quite thick and heavy.  It feels built to last and looks like very high quality fine china.  While it says you can put it in the dishwasher, I do hand wash mine.  The racks are spread far enough apart I believe you could get a toasted bagel in, if that's your thing.  Honestly, I carefully considered this purchase due to the price.  Once it arrived and I used it? I could not be happier.  If you like your toast crispy, this is the only toast rack worth the money... in my opinion of course.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should info come up that would be helpful.  It arrived quickly, well packaged and in perfect condition.  I do have prime.

description: Sophie Conran is an English interior designer, cook and author and part of the renowned Conran Family of lifestyle experts. She created her fabulous dinnerware collection exclusively for Portmeirion. Every item is as durable and functional as it is beautiful. With its simplistic and organic nature, it is perfect for every style and taste. Every item is made of the highest quality porcelain and meets the hard-wearing needs of today's family and culinary experts. Available in several colors and a wide range of dinnerware, serveware, accessories and cookware, the look can be as simple or diverse as your tastes demand. The White Toast or Letter Rack measures 8.5" x 4.0".
